mapper.select: select e.*, d.name as dept_name from emp e left join dept d on e.dept_id = d.id where e.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into emp (id, name, gender, phone, job, image, entry_date, dept_id, status) values (#{id}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{job}, #{image}, #{entryDate}, #{deptId}, 1)
mapper.update: update emp set status = 0 where id in #{id}
